#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;
int m;
vector<vector<int>> memo;

int compute(int i, int j) {
    if (i < 0 || j < 0 || j > m + 1) return 0;
    if (memo[i][j] != -1) return memo[i][j];
    if (i == 0) {
        memo[i][j] = (j == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        return memo[i][j];
    }
    if (j == 0) {
        memo[i][j] = compute(i - 1, 1);
    } else {
        memo[i][j] = (compute(i - 1, j - 1) + compute(i - 1, j + 1)) % MOD;
    }
    return memo[i][j];
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    m = 2 * n;
    memo.assign(m + 1, vector<int>(m + 2, -1));
    memo[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= m + 1; ++j) {
            compute(i, j);
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i += 2) {
        for (int j = 1; i + j <= m; j += 2) {
            ans = (ans + memo[i][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
